Overview

Utena is a city in Utena County with a population of 28,000. A city in northeastern Lithuania surrounded by lakes and forests, known for its brewery, the Utena Castle mound, and outdoor recreation opportunities. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
